All aboard The Christmas Express!

We're getting together for our On Purpose Christmas party on Saturday, December 5 at 6:00 PM!

Wear your Christmas pajamas and join us for a potluck, a short worship, Christmas games, and time to hang out together.

We'll also have an optional white elephant gift exchange with a $25 gift limit.

The party will be in Rome, GA, and the address will be shared after you RSVP.

Please RSVP by November 28 at onpurposeya.com!

Game night is coming up!

Join us Saturday, November 14 at 6:00 PM in the Calhoun SDA Fellowship Hall for pizza, games, and a chance to hang out together.

We'll also spend some time putting together teacher baskets as we help with the school supply drive.

Bring a friend, and feel free to bring your favorite board game!

We had a great time camping together in Ellijay this past weekend!

Between the campfires, hammocks, good food, and plenty of laughs, it was nice to get away for a few days and spend time together.

Our theme for the weekend was “Abide,” and on Sabbath we spent time studying John 15 and talking about what it means to stay connected to Christ.

Thanks to everyone who came out and made it such a fun weekend!

#OnPurposeYA

How does God speak to His people? And how do we recognize His voice?
This quarter, our Young Adult Sabbath School is studying The Gift of Prophecy.
Last week, we explored how God communicates with humanity in The Creator Speaks. This week, we're continuing with The Call of a Prophet, looking at how God calls people to share His messages.
Whether you've studied prophecy for years or have questions about it, we'd love for you to join the conversation.
Saturdays at 10 AM | Calhoun SDA Church
Young Adults ages 18–35
#OnPurposeYA #SabbathSchool #CalhounGA

What a beautiful Sabbath! On July 11, the On Purpose young adults were absolutely blessed to lead out in the church service. We focused on the theme of "Overcoming," drawing deep inspiration and strength from 1 John 5.

Thank you to everyone who joined us in worship and supported our young adult ministry. Let's continue to overcome together! 🙏✨

#OnPurpose #YoungAdultMinistry #Overcoming #1John5 #SabbathWorship

Such an amazing gym night! We kicked things off with worship and a powerful reminder that setbacks are never permanent. Then we hit the courts for some basketball and volleyball. Nothing beats good competition and an even better community!
